panels.title: Ground stations leaderboard by observed frames
panels.description: Cumulative received SunCET frames in the selected range, grouped by SatNOGS ground station.

panels.title: Last frame received by
panels.description: Ground station credited on the latest selected SunCET frame.

targets.query: SELECT last("pid"), "observer" AS "station" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Last frame (UTC)
panels.description: SatNOGS reception time of the latest selected SunCET frame.

panels.title: Selected frames count
panels.description: Number of received SunCET frames in the selected time range.

panels.title: CDH mode
panels.description: CTDB 2.0.5 public engineering values. Source: mode_system_mode. Highlights only a recognized reported state. Unknown codes remain visible in the reported-value line; no state is selected for missing or unknown data. State colors follow mission-owner display preferences.

targets.query: SELECT "mode_system_mode", "mode_system_mode" AS "PHOENIX", "mode_system_mode" AS "PHOENIX_text_color", "mode_system_mode" AS "SAFE", "mode_system_mode" AS "SAFE_text_color", "mode_system_mode" AS "DOWNLINK", "mode_system_mode" AS "DOWNLINK_text_color", "mode_system_mode" AS "SCIENCE", "mode_system_mode" AS "SCIENCE_text_color" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: ADCS mode
panels.description: CTDB 2.0.5 public engineering values. Source: adcs_mode. Highlights only a recognized reported state. Unknown codes remain visible in the reported-value line; no state is selected for missing or unknown data. State colors follow mission-owner display preferences.

targets.query: SELECT "adcs_mode", "adcs_mode" AS "SUN_POINT", "adcs_mode" AS "SUN_POINT_text_color", "adcs_mode" AS "FINE_REF_POINT", "adcs_mode" AS "FINE_REF_POINT_text_color" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Sun-pointing state
panels.description: CTDB 2.0.5 public engineering values. Source: adcs_sun_point_state. Highlights only a recognized reported state. Unknown codes remain visible in the reported-value line; no state is selected for missing or unknown data. State colors follow mission-owner display preferences.

targets.query: SELECT "adcs_sun_point_state", "adcs_sun_point_state" AS "FINE_REF_POINT", "adcs_sun_point_state" AS "FINE_REF_POINT_text_color", "adcs_sun_point_state" AS "ON_SUN", "adcs_sun_point_state" AS "ON_SUN_text_color", "adcs_sun_point_state" AS "SUN_POINT", "adcs_sun_point_state" AS "SUN_POINT_text_color", "adcs_sun_point_state" AS "CONVERGING", "adcs_sun_point_state" AS "CONVERGING_text_color", "adcs_sun_point_state" AS "SEARCHING", "adcs_sun_point_state" AS "SEARCHING_text_color", "adcs_sun_point_state" AS "SEARCH_INIT", "adcs_sun_point_state" AS "SEARCH_INIT_text_color", "adcs_sun_point_state" AS "NOT_ACTV", "adcs_sun_point_state" AS "NOT_ACTV_text_color", "adcs_sun_point_state" AS "WAITING", "adcs_sun_point_state" AS "WAITING_text_color" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: UHF health
panels.description: CTDB 2.0.5 public engineering values. Source: uhf_alive. Highlights only a recognized reported state. Unknown codes remain visible in the reported-value line; no state is selected for missing or unknown data. State colors follow mission-owner display preferences.

targets.query: SELECT "uhf_alive", "uhf_alive" AS "OFF", "uhf_alive" AS "OFF_text_color", "uhf_alive" AS "ALIVE", "uhf_alive" AS "ALIVE_text_color", "uhf_alive" AS "DEAD", "uhf_alive" AS "DEAD_text_color" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Packet identity & reset count
panels.description: CTDB 2.0.5 public engineering values. One packet per summary. A sequence gap alone does not establish packet loss or reboot. Unknown state codes retain their numeric value. Fields: ccsds_apid, ccsds_sequence_count, num_sc_resets.

targets.query: SELECT "ccsds_apid", "ccsds_sequence_count", "num_sc_resets" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Spacecraft clock & elapsed time
panels.description: CTDB 2.0.5 public engineering values. Raw spacecraft clock: coarse seconds since 2000-01-01T00:00:00Z plus fine milliseconds / 1000. UTC/leap-second display policy remains unvalidated. Unknown state codes retain their numeric value. Fields: spacecraft_time_seconds_since_2000, spacecraft_time_milliseconds, time_since_boot, time_alive, time_mission_elapsed_time, mode_seconds_since_mode_change.

targets.query: SELECT "spacecraft_time_seconds_since_2000", "spacecraft_time_milliseconds", "time_since_boot", "time_alive", "time_mission_elapsed_time", "mode_seconds_since_mode_change" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: ADCS / XACT
panels.description: CTDB 2.0.5 public engineering values. Latest single packet in the selected range. Source: eps_pwr_state_adcs. EPS power-enable flag, not subsystem health.

targets.query: SELECT "eps_pwr_state_adcs" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: CSIE • EUV imager
panels.description: CTDB 2.0.5 public engineering values. Latest single packet in the selected range. Source: eps_pwr_state_csie. EPS power-enable flag, not subsystem health.

targets.query: SELECT "eps_pwr_state_csie" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Dual-SPS
panels.description: CTDB 2.0.5 public engineering values. Latest single packet in the selected range. Source: eps_pwr_state_dsps. EPS power-enable flag, not subsystem health.

targets.query: SELECT "eps_pwr_state_dsps" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: UHF radio
panels.description: CTDB 2.0.5 public engineering values. Latest single packet in the selected range. Source: eps_pwr_state_uhf. EPS power-enable flag, not subsystem health.

targets.query: SELECT "eps_pwr_state_uhf" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: X-band radio
panels.description: CTDB 2.0.5 public engineering values. Latest single packet in the selected range. Source: eps_pwr_state_xband. EPS power-enable flag, not subsystem health.

targets.query: SELECT "eps_pwr_state_xband" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Battery 1 voltage gauge
panels.description: CTDB 2.0.5 public engineering values. Latest single packet in the selected range. Source: battery_1_voltage. Display scale 12–16 V. Mission-owner display bands: red below 13.2 V, yellow from 13.2 to 14 V, green at 14 V and above. Unit inferred in CTDB public schema; engineering conversion applied once.

targets.query: SELECT "battery_1_voltage" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Battery 2 voltage gauge
panels.description: CTDB 2.0.5 public engineering values. Latest single packet in the selected range. Source: battery_2_voltage. Display scale 12–16 V. Mission-owner display bands: red below 13.2 V, yellow from 13.2 to 14 V, green at 14 V and above. Unit inferred in CTDB public schema; engineering conversion applied once.

targets.query: SELECT "battery_2_voltage" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: EPS bus voltage gauge
panels.description: CTDB 2.0.5 public engineering values. Latest single packet in the selected range. Source: eps_bus_voltage. Display scale 12–16 V. Mission-owner display bands: red below 13.2 V, yellow from 13.2 to 14 V, green at 14 V and above. Unit inferred in CTDB public schema; engineering conversion applied once.

targets.query: SELECT "eps_bus_voltage" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Battery 1 power
panels.description: Derived electrical power. Positive/green is charging; negative/red is discharging. Voltage, current, and charging state come from the same beacon packet.

targets.query: SELECT "battery_1_voltage" * "battery_1_charge_current" AS "Battery 1 charging power" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter AND "battery_1_charging_state" = 1 ORDER BY time ASC
SELECT -1 * "battery_1_voltage" * "battery_1_charge_current" AS "Battery 1 discharging power" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter AND "battery_1_charging_state" = 0 ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Battery 1 voltage
panels.description: Battery 1 terminal voltage from each public beacon packet.

targets.query: SELECT "battery_1_voltage" AS "Battery 1 voltage" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Battery 1 charge current
panels.description: Battery charge-current magnitude, colored by the corresponding charging-state bit. Green means charging; red means discharging. The state is evaluated from the same packet.

targets.query: SELECT "battery_1_charge_current" AS "Battery 1 charging" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter AND "battery_1_charging_state" = 1 ORDER BY time ASC
SELECT "battery_1_charge_current" AS "Battery 1 discharging" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter AND "battery_1_charging_state" = 0 ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Battery 2 power
panels.description: Derived electrical power. Positive/green is charging; negative/red is discharging. Voltage, current, and charging state come from the same beacon packet.

targets.query: SELECT "battery_2_voltage" * "battery_2_charge_current" AS "Battery 2 charging power" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter AND "battery_2_charging_state" = 1 ORDER BY time ASC
SELECT -1 * "battery_2_voltage" * "battery_2_charge_current" AS "Battery 2 discharging power" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter AND "battery_2_charging_state" = 0 ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Battery 2 voltage
panels.description: Battery 2 terminal voltage from each public beacon packet.

targets.query: SELECT "battery_2_voltage" AS "Battery 2 voltage" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Battery 2 charge current
panels.description: Battery charge-current magnitude, colored by the corresponding charging-state bit. Green means charging; red means discharging. The state is evaluated from the same packet.

targets.query: SELECT "battery_2_charge_current" AS "Battery 2 charging" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter AND "battery_2_charging_state" = 1 ORDER BY time ASC
SELECT "battery_2_charge_current" AS "Battery 2 discharging" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter AND "battery_2_charging_state" = 0 ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: EPS bus power
panels.description: Derived from EPS bus voltage × EPS bus current in each beacon packet.

targets.query: SELECT "eps_bus_voltage" * "eps_bus_current" AS "EPS bus power" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: EPS bus voltage
panels.description: EPS bus voltage. The 3.3 V reference rail is intentionally omitted from this operational plot.

targets.query: SELECT "eps_bus_voltage" AS "EPS bus voltage" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: EPS bus current
panels.description: EPS bus current. The 3.3 V reference-rail current is intentionally omitted from this operational plot.

targets.query: SELECT "eps_bus_current" AS "EPS bus current" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Solar array power
panels.description: Derived from the voltage × current pair for each solar-array string in each beacon packet.

targets.query: SELECT "solar_array_8_cell_string_voltage" * "solar_array_8_cell_string_current" AS "combined 8-cell strings", "solar_array_9_cell_string_voltage" * "solar_array_9_cell_string_current" AS "combined 9-cell strings" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Solar array voltage
panels.description: Combined solar-array string voltages; blue is the 8-cell strings and purple is the 9-cell strings.

targets.query: SELECT "solar_array_8_cell_string_voltage" AS "combined 8-cell strings", "solar_array_9_cell_string_voltage" AS "combined 9-cell strings" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Solar array current
panels.description: Combined solar-array string currents; blue is the 8-cell strings and purple is the 9-cell strings.

targets.query: SELECT "solar_array_8_cell_string_current" AS "combined 8-cell strings", "solar_array_9_cell_string_current" AS "combined 9-cell strings" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: ADCS validity
panels.description: CTDB 2.0.5 public engineering values. Inspect these validity flags before interpreting numerical pointing measurements. Unknown state codes retain their numeric value. Fields: adcs_att_valid, adcs_ref_valid, adcs_time_valid.

targets.query: SELECT "adcs_att_valid", "adcs_ref_valid", "adcs_time_valid" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Sun pointing error
panels.description: CTDB 2.0.5 public engineering values. Interpret with ADCS validity flags; a number alone does not establish a valid pointing estimate. Unknown state codes retain their numeric value. Fields: adcs_sun_point_angle_error. Display axis: 0–10°. The legend shows the actual maximum in the selected range, including values above 10°; samples are not clipped or discarded.

targets.query: SELECT "adcs_sun_point_angle_error" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Spacecraft body rates
panels.description: CTDB 2.0.5 public engineering values.  Unknown state codes retain their numeric value. Fields: adcs_body_rate_1, adcs_body_rate_2, adcs_body_rate_3.

targets.query: SELECT "adcs_body_rate_1", "adcs_body_rate_2", "adcs_body_rate_3" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Reaction wheel speeds
panels.description: CTDB 2.0.5 public engineering values.  Unknown state codes retain their numeric value. Fields: adcs_wheel_speed_1, adcs_wheel_speed_2, adcs_wheel_speed_3.

targets.query: SELECT "adcs_wheel_speed_1", "adcs_wheel_speed_2", "adcs_wheel_speed_3" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Solar array temperatures
panels.description: Solar-array temperatures; blue is +Y and purple is -Y.

targets.query: SELECT "sa_plus_y_temp" AS "+Y solar array", "sa_minus_y_temp" AS "-Y solar array" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Spacecraft temperatures
panels.description: Bus, battery, radio, ADCS wheel 1, and DSPS temperatures. APID 1 has no Battery 2 temperature field.

targets.query: SELECT "cdh_temp" AS "CDH", "eps_temp" AS "EPS", "ifb_therm1" AS "Interface Board", "battery_1_temp" AS "Battery 1", "batt_board_temp" AS "Battery board", "uhf_temp" AS "UHF radio", "xband_pa_temp" AS "X-band radio", "adcs_ana_motor1_temp" AS "ADCS wheel 1", "dsps_sensor_board_temp" AS "DSPS" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: CSIE temperature
panels.description: CSIE EUV-imager electronics temperature. Values above 100 °C are the powered-off sentinel and are omitted.

targets.query: SELECT "csie_temp" AS "CSIE" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter AND "csie_temp" <= 100 ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Radio state & data source
panels.description: Latest X-band data-source selection. UHF health is shown in the health-and-status section above.

targets.query: SELECT "xband_data_source" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Radio power
panels.description: Derived electrical input power. The X-band PA series uses the reported X-band voltage × PA current.

targets.query: SELECT "uhf_voltage" * "uhf_current" AS "UHF power", "xband_voltage" * "xband_current" AS "X-band electronics power", "xband_voltage" * "xband_pa_current" AS "X-band PA power" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Radio voltage
panels.description: Radio supply voltages; blue is UHF and purple is X-band.

targets.query: SELECT "uhf_voltage" AS "UHF radio", "xband_voltage" AS "X-band radio" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Radio current
panels.description: Radio currents; blue is UHF, purple is X-band electronics, and orange is the X-band PA.

targets.query: SELECT "uhf_current" AS "UHF radio", "xband_current" AS "X-band electronics", "xband_pa_current" AS "X-band PA" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Task & watchpoint states
panels.description: CTDB 2.0.5 public engineering values. Watchpoint numbers retain their published identifiers. ENABLED describes configuration; it does not mean a fault occurred. Unknown state codes retain their numeric value. Fields: fault_protection_task_state, fault_protection_watchpoint_0_state, fault_protection_watchpoint_1_state, fault_protection_watchpoint_2_state, fault_protection_watchpoint_3_state, fault_protection_watchpoint_4_state, fault_protection_watchpoint_5_state, fault_protection_watchpoint_6_state.

targets.query: SELECT "fault_protection_task_state", "fault_protection_watchpoint_0_state", "fault_protection_watchpoint_1_state", "fault_protection_watchpoint_2_state", "fault_protection_watchpoint_3_state", "fault_protection_watchpoint_4_state", "fault_protection_watchpoint_5_state", "fault_protection_watchpoint_6_state" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Payload • EUV imager & Dual Sun Position Sensor
Instrument activity
panels.description: Latest CSIE capture state. Payload EPS power states are shown in the subsystem-power section above.

targets.query: SELECT "csie_capture_state" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Payload power
panels.description: Derived from the voltage × current pair for each payload in each beacon packet.

targets.query: SELECT "csie_voltage" * "csie_current" AS "CSIE power", "dsps_voltage" * "dsps_current" AS "Dual-SPS power" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Payload voltages
panels.description: CTDB 2.0.5 public engineering values.  Unknown state codes retain their numeric value. Fields: csie_voltage, dsps_voltage. Schema units are inferred for: csie_voltage, dsps_voltage.

targets.query: SELECT "csie_voltage", "dsps_voltage" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Payload currents
panels.description: CTDB 2.0.5 public engineering values.  Unknown state codes retain their numeric value. Fields: csie_current, dsps_current. Schema units are inferred for: csie_current, dsps_current.

targets.query: SELECT "csie_current", "dsps_current" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Dual-SPS flare threshold
panels.description: CTDB 2.0.5 public engineering values.  Unknown state codes retain their numeric value. Fields: dsps_flare_level.

targets.query: SELECT "dsps_flare_level" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Dual-SPS flare magnitude
panels.description: CTDB 2.0.5 public engineering values. Unsigned raw magnitude; no approved CTDB 2.0.5 engineering conversion. Unknown state codes retain their numeric value. Fields: dsps_flare_magnitude.

targets.query: SELECT "dsps_flare_magnitude" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Dual-SPS flare phase
panels.description: CTDB 2.0.5 public engineering values.  Unknown state codes retain their numeric value. Fields: dsps_flare_phase.

targets.query: SELECT "dsps_flare_phase" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: CSIE image histogram • default DN bins
panels.description: CTDB 2.0.5 public engineering values. Pixel counts from one packet, plotted directly in six transmitted bins. DN ranges assume offset 0 and width 32; update labels if configuration changes. Full image: 1504 × 2000 = 3,008,000 pixels; these six bins need not sum to that total.

targets.query: SELECT "csie_img_hist_0" AS "0–31", "csie_img_hist_1" AS "32–63", "csie_img_hist_2" AS "64–95", "csie_img_hist_3" AS "96–127", "csie_img_hist_4" AS "128–159", "csie_img_hist_5" AS "160–191" FROM "98244" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
